subject: Polity
caption:
Lok Sabha ka Speaker kis Article se banta hai? 🤔 Jawaab hai Article 93, lekin Speaker vote kab deta hai, ye bhi jaanna zaroori hai!

📜 Article 93: Lok Sabha apne members mein se Speaker chunti hai
🧑‍⚖️ 1952: G.V. Mavalankar bane Lok Sabha ke pehle Speaker
🚫 Normally: Speaker vote nahi deta
⚖️ Tie hone par: Speaker casting vote deta hai

Comment karo: Speaker apna vote kab deta hai? A) Har bill par ya B) Tie hone par
Save karo revision ke liye 📌 aur Follow karo @sarkari.ki.taiyari

first_comment: Answer: B) Tie hone par. Speaker normally vote nahi deta — sirf tie hone par casting vote deta hai.
